categories.main_business_segments: Juroku Financial Group, Inc. operates primarily in two business segments: banking and leasing. The banking segment, led by Juroku Bank, provides deposit, lending, securities trading, investment, domestic and foreign exchange, bond trustee, and derivative transactions, with a focus on serving as a regional financial partner. The leasing segment, through Juroku Lease, addresses regional leasing needs. Other group companies provide research, securities, credit card, digital payment, M&A advisory, investment fund management, and regional revitalization consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The group leverages advanced financial technologies, including digital banking platforms, risk management systems, and digital payment solutions. It emphasizes IT/DX (digital transformation) talent development, adoption of cloud-based collaboration tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Gemini AI), and robust risk management frameworks. The group also provides consulting services for decarbonization, utilizing GHG emissions visualization and management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The group primarily serves individual and corporate customers in the Gifu and Aichi regions, including manufacturers, public entities, SMEs, and local governments. It also targets regional businesses for consulting, leasing, and M&A advisory, and provides financial solutions to support decarbonization and sustainability initiatives. The group’s end markets are predominantly domestic, with a strong focus on regional economic development.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, especially in Gifu and Aichi prefectures, with a network of over 150 bank branches and offices. The group also maintains a limited international presence, with a small number of overseas local hires and some foreign currency transactions, but over 90% of revenue and assets are domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Juroku Financial Group operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, corporations, and public entities) as a provider of banking, leasing, and related financial solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The group’s strategic focus is on regional comprehensive financial services, digital transformation (DX), sustainability (including decarbonization and ESG finance), and human capital development. Key initiatives include expanding sustainable finance, supporting clients’ decarbonization, enhancing IT/DX capabilities, and fostering diversity and inclusion. The group aims to be a leader in regional revitalization and to achieve carbon neutrality by 2030 (Scope 1,2) and 2050 (Scope 3).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from interest income on loans, fees from banking and financial services, leasing income, securities investment returns, and commissions from consulting, M&A advisory, and digital payment services. The holding company also receives dividends from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other regional banks and financial institutions in Gifu and Aichi, as well as national banks and new entrants leveraging digital technologies. The group positions itself as a leading regional comprehensive financial services provider, leveraging its deep local network and broad service portfolio to differentiate from both traditional and digital-only competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, the group reported total assets of approximately ¥7.6 trillion, net assets of ¥423.6 billion, and consolidated ordinary income of ¥136.3 billion. Net profit attributable to parent shareholders was ¥20.8 billion, with steady growth in both profit and assets. The group maintains a strong capital base (consolidated capital adequacy ratio of 11.23%) and is on track with its mid-term plan targets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Juroku Financial Group differentiates itself through its deep regional roots, comprehensive financial service offerings, and commitment to regional revitalization and sustainability. It emphasizes personalized customer support, advanced digital solutions, and leadership in ESG and decarbonization finance, aiming to be an indispensable partner for local communities and businesses.
